lines: Hamari saanson mein aaj tak woh hina ki khushbu mahak rahi hai
couplets.en: That scent of henna still lingers on my breath.

lines: Labon pe naghme machal rahe hain
Nazar se masti chhalak rahi hai
couplets.en: A quiet intoxication spills from my eyes.

lines: Hamari saanson mein aaj tak woh hina ki khushbu mahak rahi hai
couplets.en: That scent of henna still lingers on my breath.

lines: Kabhi jo the pyaar ki zamanat, woh haath hain ghair ki amanat
couplets.en: The hands that once pledged love now belong to someone else.

lines: Jo qasmein khaate the chahaton ki, unhi ki niyat bahak rahi hai
couplets.en: The one who swore such love is the one whose heart now strays.

lines: Hamari saanson mein aaj tak woh hina ki khushbu mahak rahi hai
couplets.en: That scent of henna still lingers on my breath.

lines: Kisi se koi gila nahin hai, naseeb hi mein wafa nahin hai
couplets.en: I blame no one, for constancy was never mine to have.

lines: Jahan kahin tha hina ko khilna, hina wahin pe mahak rahi hai
couplets.en: The henna gives its scent where it was meant to bloom.

lines: Hamari saanson mein aaj tak woh hina ki khushbu mahak rahi hai
couplets.en: That scent of henna still lingers on my breath.

lines: Woh jin ke khatir ghazal kahi thi, woh jin ke khatir likhe the naghme
couplets.en: It was for that beloved I composed a ghazal and wrote my songs.

lines: Unhi ke aage sawal ban ke, ghazal ki jhanjhar chhanak rahi hai
couplets.en: Before that same beloved, the ghazal's anklet rings like a question.
